shared_elements: small incised/pecked circles or discs (circles in A, cup-marks in B)
schematic linear marks scattered over a large surface
sequences of small repeated signs arranged in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry small schematic incised marks scattered irregularly, including simple circles/discs and rows of repeated small signs, but that is a generic correspondence any linear-graffito tradition could produce. A is entirely non-figurative (lattice and cross-hatching, angular sign-like strokes, concentric circles) while B is wholly figurative (crewed boats with stroke-crews, an antlered quadruped, a line of armed human figures with weapons), so no shared subject matter or relationships exist.
